about.title: An editorial project
about.lede: The Arc Istanbul gathers contemporary art, architecture, and cinema at a slow reading pace.
about.body1: We write as observers up close, not as visitors. When covering a show, we prefer to speak with the artist; when describing a space, we visit more than once.
about.body2: The site is published in two languages — Turkish and English. Each piece arrives with an optional track chosen by the writer.
